content.text: The text combines four unrelated works. A 1697 Dutch report from Jaffna discusses slave policy, customs, elephants, pearl fisheries, horse breeding, roads, taxation, trade, and colonial administration. A novel follows John Smith/Fulton, who boards with Maggie Duff, investigates relatives’ misuse of inherited money, falls in love with Maggie, and travels from Hillerton to South America and Chicago; they ultimately plan philanthropic projects. In an adventure, Jimmie and Carl shelter in a ruined temple, enter underground passages, reach the forest and the _Ann_, then return to rescue Sam. Havens and Sam travel by aeroplane to a fortress, enter it, capture Redfern, and return to Quito. The final architectural essay surveys Chaldean, Assyrian, and Persian monuments, emphasizing ziggurats, temples, palaces, excavation, chronology, and their influence on later Asian architecture.
